{{Current events|year=2019|month=03|day=28|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)]]
**At least 11 people are killed following an explosion in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/8-killed-car-bomb-mogadishu-190328110849696.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**The [[Maritime Squadron of the Armed Forces of Malta|Maltese Navy]] seizes control of commercial tanker ''[[Elhiblu 1]]'', which was hijacked by migrants off the coast of [[Libya]] yesterday. The tanker is now docked in the Maltese capital, [[Valletta]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-47730693 (BBC)]

;Business and economy
* [[WOW air]], an [[Iceland]]ic low-cost airline, ceases operations. [https://www.icetra.is/about/press-room/news/end-of-operation-of-wow-air (Icelandic Transport Authority)] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/icelandic-budget-airline-wow-air-ceases-operations-1.5074662 (CBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*At least 32 people have died after a truck struck a crowd gathered at a road accident in western [[Guatemala]]. The group had apparently gathered on the road to inspect a person who had been killed in a separate crash when the vehicle ploughed into them. [https://news.sky.com/story/30-dead-after-truck-hits-crowd-in-guatemala-11676960 (Sky News)] 
*A fire breaks out in [[Dhaka]], [[Bangladesh]], at a 22-story tower, killing at least 19 people and injuring more than 70 others. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bangladesh-fire/fire-at-high-rise-in-bangladesh-kills-at-least-five-60-injured-many-trapped-idUSKCN1R90XO (Reuters)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/mar/28/bangladesh-high-rise-fire-dhaka-prompts-people-to-jump-from-building (''The Guardian'')]

;Law and crime
* The [[Supreme Court of the United States]] rejects a request by gun rights activists to grant a temporary stay on the Trump administration's ban on [[Bump fire|bump stock]] attachments that allow semi-automatic firearms to be fired rapidly. The policy took effect Tuesday after a similar bid to delay implementation was rejected. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-guns/us-supreme-court-refuses-to-block-trumps-gun-bump-stock-ban-idUSKCN1R9230 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis|Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**[[Venezuela]]n state comptroller Elvis Amoroso announces that opposition leader [[Juan Guaidó]] is barred from holding public office for 15 years because of  irregularities in the financial records. Guaidó, the [[National Assembly (Venezuela)|National Assembly]] leader, says he will continue his campaign to oust [[President of Venezuela|President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/juan-guaido-venezuelan-opposition-leader-barred-from-holding-office-for-15-years-live-updates-2019-03-28/ (CBS News)]
